concept.title: Notifications overview
concept.shortdesc: Notifications in Red Hat Quay alert you about repository events such as pushes, builds, and image expiry. You can configure delivery methods for users, teams, or organizations.

conbody.p: Notification entries appear on the repository Events and Notifications page and in the global Notifications panel. Delivery methods include email, webhook POST, Flowdock, HipChat, and Slack.
